2607.03325.title: From Judgments to Issues: Structured Extraction of Legal Reasoning with Citation-Hallucination Control
2607.03325.paper_summary: We present an automated pipeline that decomposes Italian tax-court judgments into individual legal issues and extracts, for each issue, a structured XML representation grounded in the IRAC framework and the legal syllogism. The pipeline targets a corpus of approximately $330{,}000$ first- and second-instance decisions of the Italian tax courts and is built around a capable yet cost-efficient general-purpose model (DeepSeek V3), a choice driven by the need to process several hundred thousand documents at a sustainable cost. To address the well-documented unreliability of large language models on legal citations, we couple the extraction step with an automatic hallucination-detection filter that compares the references produced by the model with those identified in the judgment text by a dedicated parser (Linkoln), normalised to standard identifiers (URN-NIR, ECLI, CELEX). We validate the pipeline on $50$ judgments annotated by two PhDs in tax law, computing inter-annotator agreement and LLM-vs-expert agreement on both issue extraction and legal citations, together with a stand-alone evaluation of the hallucination filter. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first issue-level, expert-validated structured extraction pipeline with hallucination control for Italian tax-court decisions, and it provides a concrete starting point for downstream applications such as issue-level retrieval, citation-network analysis, and the construction of large-scale datasets of legal reasoning.
2607.03325.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個自動化流程，將意大利稅務法院的判決分解為個別法律問題，並為每個問題提取基於IRAC框架和法律三段論的結構化XML表示。該流程針對約$330{,}000$份意大利稅務法院的一審和二審裁決，並圍繞一個能夠且具成本效益的通用模型（DeepSeek V3）構建，這一選擇是基於需要以可持續的成本處理數十萬份文件。為了解決大型語言模型在法律引用方面的可靠性問題，我們將提取步驟與自動幻覺檢測過濾器結合，該過濾器將模型生成的引用與專用解析器（Linkoln）在判決文本中識別的引用進行比較，並標準化為標準識別碼（URN-NIR, ECLI, CELEX）。我們在$50$份由兩位稅法博士標註的判決上驗證該流程，計算標註者間的一致性以及大型語言模型與專家在問題提取和法律引用方面的一致性，並對幻覺過濾器進行獨立評估。據我們所知，這是首個針對意大利稅務法院判決的問題級別、專家驗證的結構化提取流程，並具備幻覺控制，為下游應用提供了具體的起點，例如問題級檢索、引用網絡分析和大型法律推理數據集的構建。
